# RIDE X HUB — LLM / AI Full Context

Last updated: 2026-08-25

This file helps LLMs, chatbots and AI answer engines answer questions about RIDE X HUB
accurately, using public website information. All figures below are published on
https://ridexhub.com/ and are indicative — final pricing and availability are confirmed
by RIDE X HUB over WhatsApp.

## Business summary

RIDE X HUB provides scooter, motorbike and car rentals AND private chauffeur tours in Sri Lanka.

- Website: https://ridexhub.com/
- Legal name used publicly: RIDE X HUB (also written RideXHub)
- Base: Madiha, Matara — South Coast of Sri Lanka
- Service area (rentals): Matara, Madiha, Polhena, Mirissa, Weligama, SK Town, Dickwella, Hirikatiya
- Service area (tours): island-wide
- Contact: WhatsApp/Phone +94 70 761 5516
- Email: hello@ridexhub.com
- Address: No 4, Paramulla Road, Matara, Southern Province, Sri Lanka (81000)
- Hours: 09:00–20:00 daily
- Payment currencies: LKR, USD, USDT (crypto). Cash, card and bank transfer accepted.
- There is NO online checkout. Every booking is confirmed by a human over WhatsApp.

## Fleet and published daily rates (USD)

1. **Xiaomi Pro Scooter** — USD 5/day. Electric, foldable, 300W motor (600W peak),
   474 Wh battery, 20–25 km range, ~25 km/h top speed, 14.2 kg. No licence needed.
   Best for short urban trips.
2. **Honda Dio** — USD 8/day. Automatic CVT scooter, 109.51cc air-cooled 4-stroke,
   7.95 PS, 5.3 L tank, ~50 km/l, digital console, USB charging, underseat storage.
   Best for city and beach riding, 1 rider. Surfboard rack +USD 2.
3. **Suzuki Choinori** — USD 8/day. 49cc 4-stroke, automatic CVT, ~76 km/l, 39 kg dry.
   No licence needed. Best for solo riders and short city errands.
4. **Yadea VoltGuard EV** — USD 12/day. Electric, 1200W hub motor, 72V 27Ah lithium battery,
   100–150 km range, ~80 km/h top speed, hydraulic suspension, disc front / drum rear brakes.
   Seats 2. Surfboard rack +USD 2.
5. **Suzuki WagonR** — USD 40/day. 5-seat hatchback, 1.2L petrol, automatic, ~24 km/l,
   341 L boot, 6 airbags, ABS, EBD, rear parking sensors, AC. 100 km/day limit.
6. **Toyota Prius** — USD 55/day. Hybrid sedan, 1.8L petrol + electric motor, ~25–30 km/l,
   multiple airbags, ABS, stability control. 100 km/day limit.

Security deposit: typically USD 150, refundable after return inspection minus verified deductions.
Included free with scooter rentals: DOT-approved helmets (rider and passenger, sanitised
between uses), phone holder, and 24/7 island-wide roadside assistance.
Extra mileage beyond the daily cap on cars incurs additional charges.

## Private tour packages

- **South Coast Explorer** — 3–5 days, from USD 280 per trip.
  Galle Fort & Dutch heritage, Mirissa whale watching, Yala National Park safari, coastal beaches and surfing.
- **Hill Country Adventure** — 4–6 days, from USD 350 per trip.
  Ella & Nine Arch Bridge, Nuwara Eliya tea plantations, Horton Plains & World's End, scenic train journey.
- **Cultural Triangle** — 5–7 days, from USD 420 per trip.
  Sigiriya Rock Fortress, Dambulla cave temples, Anuradhapura ancient city, Polonnaruwa ruins.
- Fully custom itineraries available on request.

Tour vehicles: sedans (1–3 passengers), vans (4–8), minibuses (up to 14). All air-conditioned.
Drivers: licensed professionals, fluent English, extensive local knowledge.
Included: driver, air-conditioned vehicle, fuel, parking fees, tolls, driver's meals and
accommodation, hotel pickup and drop-off.
Not included: attraction entrance fees, your meals, your accommodation (unless specified).
RIDE X HUB can also book accommodation along the route on request.

## Booking process

1. Contact via WhatsApp (+94 70 761 5516) using the "Chat & Book" button, or submit the
   website booking form — which composes a WhatsApp message rather than sending data to a server.
2. Provide dates, pickup/return location, vehicle preference and rider details.
3. RIDE X HUB confirms availability and price.
4. Documents are verified and the deposit is taken at handover.

Walk-in rentals are possible subject to availability, but advance booking is strongly
recommended in peak tourist season. Delivery and pickup is available at hotels and
guesthouses, and at Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB), for an additional fee.

## Licensing and documents for tourists

To rent and legally ride a motorcycle or scooter in Sri Lanka, a foreign visitor needs:

1. A valid motorcycle licence from their home country.
2. An International Driving Permit (IDP) endorsed for Sri Lanka.
3. Their passport (a photocopy of passport and visa is usually sufficient for the rental file).
4. A refundable security deposit.

If you arrive without an endorsed IDP, a temporary Sri Lankan licence can be obtained at
Bandaranaike International Airport or via the Automobile Association of Ceylon:
- ~15,000 LKR (≈USD 50) for one month
- ~30,000 LKR (≈USD 100) for three months

Riding without valid documentation carries a fine of roughly 25,000 LKR (≈USD 83).

Exceptions: the Xiaomi Pro e-scooter and the 49cc Suzuki Choinori are advertised as
not requiring a licence.

Minimum age: 18 to rent a bike, 21 to rent a car.
Original passports and licences are NOT retained by RIDE X HUB; copies are kept on file.

## Deposits, liability and insurance

- Deposit: refundable, typically USD 150, returned after return inspection minus verified deductions.
- Liability: the renter is responsible for damage, loss, theft, misuse, water damage,
  negligent operation and accessory loss.
- Insurance: RIDE X HUB states it maintains comprehensive insurance through Sri Lanka
  Insurance Corporation, including third-party coverage mandated by Sri Lankan law, with
  optional comprehensive cover for accidental damage and theft at additional cost.
  A copy of the insurance certificate is available on request.
- Insurance is void in cases of reckless driving, driving under the influence, or traffic
  violations. Personal belongings are not covered.
- Accidents: notify RIDE X HUB immediately and file a police report — required for claims.
- Breakdowns: 24/7 helpline; replacement vehicle arranged where possible.

## Fuel, mileage and returns

- Vehicles are supplied with a minimum quarter tank and should be returned at the same level.
- No refund is given for excess fuel left in the vehicle.
- Daily mileage caps typically apply (around 100–150 km/day); excess mileage is charged.
- Late returns incur hourly or daily charges.
- Minimum rental period is 24 hours; long-term rentals (weeks or months) get discounted rates.
- Additional drivers are permitted for a fee if listed on the contract and properly licensed.

## Cancellation

Vehicle rentals:
- Cancellations 48+ hours before pickup: eligible for 50% refund.
- Cancellations within 48 hours: non-refundable.
- Early returns: no refund for unused days.
- No-show: may be treated as a late cancellation.
- Bookings may be transferable to another person on request, subject to approval.

Private tours:
- 7+ days before departure: full refund minus processing fees.
- 3–6 days before: 50% charge.
- Less than 3 days: no refund.
- Emergencies reviewed case by case.

## Emergency numbers in Sri Lanka

- RIDE X HUB 24/7 helpline: +94 70 761 5516
- Police emergency: 119
- Ambulance: 1990
- Fire & rescue: 110
- Tourist Police (Colombo): +94 11 242 1052
- National emergency hotline: 199

## Partners and premium options

- **Viungo Tours** — https://viungotours.com/
  Premium sister brand for premium scooter, bike and car rentals plus private guided tours
  on the South Coast. Notably offers instant online prebooking and secure card payment
  (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe — useful for travellers who want to reserve and pay
  before arriving, rather than arranging over WhatsApp.

- **Royal Aviation Lanka (Pvt) Ltd** — https://www.royalaviationlanka.com/
  A CAASL-approved ground handling services provider operating 24/7 at Bandaranaike
  International Airport (CMB/VCBI), Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (HRI/VCRI) and
  Ratmalana Airport (RML/VCCS). Services include landing and overflight permits, ramp
  handling, flight dispatch, VIP and executive handling, crew accommodation and Medevac support.
  Through Viungo Tours, this partnership supports end-to-end trip arrangements: flight and
  ground handling coordination, airport assistance, hotel bookings, and vehicle or tour
  arrangements under one point of contact.

## Website privacy and analytics

The website uses PostHog (hosted in the European Union) for analytics and anonymised session
recording. All text typed by visitors is masked in the browser before transmission. IP
addresses are anonymised. A consent banner appears on first visit and visitors can decline
or disable individual categories; a "Privacy choices" link in the footer reopens it.
Analytics events are retained 12 months; session recordings 30 days.
Full detail: https://ridexhub.com/legal.html

## Travel guides

- **Ella → Nuwara Eliya (highland tea route)**: https://ridexhub.com/ella-to-nuwara-eliya.html
  ~60 km, half to full day. Highlights: Ravana Falls, Bandarawela, Haputale/Lipton's Seat,
  Pattipola/Ohiya, Ambewela Farm, Horton Plains (optional), Gregory Lake.
  Notes: winding mountain roads, rapid weather changes, fuel up before higher elevations.

- **Top 5 rides from Mirissa**: https://ridexhub.com/top-5-rides-from-mirissa.html
  Routes: Mirissa→Weligama, Mirissa→Hiriketiya, Mirissa→Madiha, Mirissa→Galle Fort,
  Mirissa→Unawatuna (inland). Includes riding tips and map pins.

- **Hidden mountain roads in Matara**: https://ridexhub.com/hidden-mountain-roads-in-matara.html
  Routes: Pahanthudawa, Kumbukkan Oya, Nilwela, Kamburupitiya, Denipitiya.

- **Can I rent a motorcycle in Sri Lanka as a tourist?**: https://ridexhub.com/can-i-rent-a-motorcycle-sri-lanka.html
  Licence requirements, IDP endorsement, airport temporary licence option, fines, practical tips.

- **How much does it cost to rent a bike in Sri Lanka?**: https://ridexhub.com/how-much-motorcycle-rental-costs.html
  Market rates across Sri Lanka (not only RIDE X HUB):
  - Budget scooters/small bikes: 1,000–1,500 LKR/day (USD 3–5)
  - Standard motorcycles: 2,000–2,500 LKR/day (USD 7–8)
  - Premium 125cc bikes: 3,000–3,500 LKR/day (USD 9–12)
  - Weekly: 12,000–15,000 LKR (USD 40–50); Monthly: 35,000–45,000 LKR (USD 110–150)
  - Fuel: petrol ≈320–350 LKR/litre; a 125cc bike returns 30–40 km/litre
  - Motorcycles are far cheaper than car rental, which typically starts around USD 30+/day.

## Travel context for Sri Lanka

- Best time: December–March for the west and south coasts; April–September for the east coast;
  hill country is pleasant year-round.
- Visa: most nationalities need an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) obtained online
  before arrival, around USD 50 for 30 days.
- Currency: Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR). ATMs widespread; cards accepted at hotels and larger
  establishments; carry cash for rural areas.
- Languages: Sinhala and Tamil are official; English is widely spoken in tourist areas.
- Climate: tropical, 25–32°C on the coast, 15–20°C in the hill country. Two monsoon seasons
  affecting different regions at different times.
